noun_definition: web refers to the user interface of the application where users can interact with features such as requesting money and navigating through top tab options.
Request money refers to the action initiated by the user through the Floating Action Button (FAB) to prompt a transaction for receiving funds.
Hover indicator refers to a visual cue that should appear when the user hovers over the top tab options ("Manual", "Scan", and "Distance") in the request money interface, but is currently absent.
Top tab option refers to the selectable categories labeled "Manual", "Scan", and "Distance" that appear at the top of the request money interface in the web application.
